AliMed® Trendelenburg Stabilizer safely and securely positions patients of any size for all surgical procedures requiring supine, left or right tilt, lithotomy, or Trendelenburg positions, up to a 35° angle. products.name: Trulife Pectus Carinatum Brace
products.description: Trulife Pectus Carinatum Brace is a prefabricated bracing solution for chest wall deformities, including pigeon chest. Features a low-profile design with an anterior panel (4-1/4"W x 3-1/2"H) for a posterior-directed force, a posterior panel (4-3/4"W x 6"H) for an anterior-directed force, and four lateral padded panels that contour around the chest. Panels are made from a low-density polyethylene that is flexible enough to easily conform around the patient's chest to create an intimate and concealed fit. Over time, the patient's body heat helps to mold the plastic panels around the chest for an even better custom fit. Covered in a washable foam liner for additional patient comfort. Ratchet closure and bendable metal components for an adjustable fit. One size fits most up to a 35" chest circumference.What is Pectus Carinatum? Pectus carinatum (PC) is an anterior chest wall deformity associated with abnormal growth and development of the costal rib cartilages and sternum that is observed as an outward protrusion, tilt, or convexity on the anterior chest wall and often includes the sternum and associated ribs. The PC prominence may be either asymmetrical or symmetrical. Accurately identifying the type of Pectus Carinatum deformity is a crucial step in predicting the success of orthotic outcomes. PC orthosis design is based on Wolff ’s Law that when healthy bone and cartilage are loaded with a constant and increasing force, they will adapt, strengthen, and gradually remodel. A PC orthosis has two opposing forces, one directly over the apex of the prominence and one on the thoracic spine. Over time, this continuous force arrests further anterior cartilaginous growth and gradually remodels the rib cage into a more normal, flattened shape. The PC orthosis is worn until skeletal maturity is reached.

products.name: CARBOLIME® Carbon Dioxide Absorber
products.description: CARBOLIME® is a granular soda lime absorbent designed for efficient carbon dioxide removal in closed and semi-closed breathing circuits. Low dust formulation, optimized particle size, and lower bulk density help reduce waste and maintenance while lowering the risk of carbon monoxide formation. Hard, irregularly shaped granules have been processed to minimize dust formation from friction. No KOH—minimum anesthetic agent degredation. CARBOLIME has a moisture content of 12-19% and is manufactured with a hardness and porosity which delivers dependable, efficient CO2 absorption. Contains a precise mixture of calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)2), water, a small amount of sodium hydroxide (NaOH), and a small amount of ethyl violet, which acts as a color indicator when nearing absorption exhaustion. Color changes from white to violet when it is time to discard and replace the absorbent, ensuring safe, consistent performance and preventing any chance of re-use. Refill Bag available (sold separately). 12 canisters per case.2.5-lb. canistersNote: Fresh Carbolime has a white to off-white color. As CO2 absorption reaches its capacity, the Carbolime granules distinctively change to violet. This violet color intensifies to indicate exhaustion of the soda lime. When the violet color has penetrated through half the depth of the Carbolime absorber, the absorbent capacity of the canister is exhausted and the material should be discarded and replaced. It is essential to empty canisters immediately after exhaustion. If exhausted Carbolime is left to stand, the violet color will begin to revert to white within a few hours. Although Carbolime may appear to return to a fresh state, it cannot be regenerated and should never be re-used. The absorbent should be changed when uncertain of the state of hydration, such as if fresh gas flow has been left on for an extensive or indeterminate amount of time.

As CO2 absorption reaches its capacity, the Carbolime granules distinctively change to violet. This violet color intensifies to indicate exhaustion of the soda lime. When the violet color has penetrated through half the depth of the Carbolime absorber, the absorbent capacity of the canister is exhausted and the material should be discarded and replaced. It is essential to empty canisters immediately after exhaustion. If exhausted Carbolime is left to stand, the violet color will begin to revert to white within a few hours. products.name: Preschool Apraxia Cards
products.description: Preschool Apraxia Cards treat childhood apraxia of speech with appealing preschool pictures and a precise, organized hierarchy of word selections and prompts for children ages 3 to 7. This 240-card set has an evidence-based progression, moving from basic syllable sequences to multisyllabic word production in sentences. The stimuli are phonetically controlled which introduces one phonemic variable at a time. The nine sections of stimuli are carefully arranged to give a precise progression of demand on the child's motor planning skills from VC/CV through multisyllabic word. A five-level cueing hierarchy on each card supports the progression of demand on motor planning, move children through all five cueing levels as motor-planning skills improve. Cueing hierarchy for sections 1 through 7 includes Cloze sentence, Supply the rhyming word, Answer a wh- question, Say the target word three times, and Repeat a sentence that contains the target word. Cueing hierarchy for sections 8 and 9 are Say the target word using forward chaining, Cloze sentence, Answer a wh- question, Say the target word three times, and Repeat a sentence that contains the target word. The 240 cards are further categorized with markers of the syllable type, sound placement, and vowels used in each word.Includes 240 coated cards (3-1/2"W x 5"H) and nine header cards.

products.name: Severo® Electric Pill Grinder
products.description: Severo® Electric Pill Grinder quickly and safely grinds pills into a fine powder with the push of a button—eliminating the time, effort, and physical strain of manual crushing. Ideal for patients who have difficulty swallowing pills, this one-touch device streamlines medication prep while protecting healthcare staff from exposure to harmful medication dust. Its closed grinding system reduces airborne particles, spills, and cross-contamination, supporting user safety and helping to prevent medication loss. Designed for efficiency, the Electric Pill Grinder grinds pills in just 8 seconds and delivers up to 500 grinding cycles per charge. A single container is used to grind, seal, and administer medication—helping reduce waste and simplify cleanup. Ideal for hospitals, rehab centers, long-term care, and home health settings. It’s easy to use: simply put pills in the Medication Cup, place the Anti-Contamination Divider on top of the cup, and position the Grinding Head on top of the divider. Insert the cup into the grinder, close the lid, and press the button. Within seconds, the medication is ground and ready for mixing with liquid or gel, or for administration via feeding tubes. Kit includes Electric Pill Grinder unit with metal grinding head, magnetic stability plate, 25 Medication Cups with Lids, 25 Anti-Contamination Dividers, and power cord.Grinder unit: 2-3/4"W x 8-5/8"H x 3-1/4"D • 3.3 lbs. • Stainless steel grinding head • LED battery-life indicator • AC/DC power cord • 2-year warranty on grinder unit • 6-month warranty on rechargeable batteryAdditional accessories also available (sold separately): Medication Cup, Lid, and Anti-Contamination Divider Kits; Metal Grinding Head; and Power Cord.
